STANDARD ADVERTISING TERMS AND CONDITIONS
These TEGNA Inc. (“ TEGNA”) Standard Advertising Terms and Conditions (these “ Standard Terms”) govern the purchase and placement of broadcast 
television, radio and/or digital advertising campaigns (each a “ Campaign”) by or on behalf of the advertiser or agency (in each case, “ Advertiser”) 
identified in an order confirmation (the “ Confirmation”) issued by an applicable TEGNA affiliate, including without limitation, TEGNA television stations, 
Premion, and/or Locked On Podcast Network (each a “ TEGNA Affiliate”), in response to a media order submitted to the applicable TEGNA Affiliate by or 
on behalf of the Advertiser (“ Order”).   These Standard Terms, together with the Confirmation and any applicable Addendum(s) or policies expressly 
referenced herein, are collectively referred to herein as the “ Agreement.”  For avoidance of doubt, the parties to this Agreement are Advertiser and the 
TEGNA Affiliate that issues the applicable Confirmation.  Except where the context otherwise necessitates a different interpretation, references in the 
terms and conditions below to “TEGNA” will be deemed to be references to such TEGNA Affiliate.
1. Orders.  The details regarding Advertiser’s purchase of particular Campaigns (e.g., run dates, rates, ad sizes, etc.) will be set forth in the 
Confirmation.  Confirmations may be issued in a physical copy or electronically, including, without limitation, via email, via TEGNA’s 
acceptance/confirmation of an Order via an electronic ordering system (e.g., FreeWheel’s ePort system or Mediaocean’s DARE system) and/or through a 
supply side advertising platform (SSP).  In the event of any conflict between the Order and the Confirmation, the Confirmation will control.  The Order is 
not considered part of this Agreement.  TEGNA will be under no obligation to accept any particular Order.  
2. Term. The term of this Agreement will commence as of the date this Agreement is deemed accepted by Advertiser (as described in Section 15.8, 
below) and will continue in effect for all Confirmations issued thereafter unless and until terminated as set forth herein (“Term”).  
3. Economic Terms.
3.1. Fees.  Fees for each Campaign purchased by Advertiser hereunder will be calculated based on TEGNA’s standard rate card, or such other rate 
agreed to by Advertiser and TEGNA and specified in the Confirmation.  Invoices will be issued in accordance with TEGNA’s records and will be deemed 
final with respect to all charges set forth therein.  
3.2. Payment.  Unless TEGNA has granted Advertiser credit terms, as described in Section 3.3, below, payment in full is due no later than five (5) 
business days prior to the Campaign start date.   This Section 3.2 does not apply if Advertiser has been granted credit (and such grant has not been 
revoked) pursuant to Section 3.3 below. 
3.3. Credit Terms. Notwithstanding Section 3.2, above, TEGNA may grant credit terms to Advertiser, subject to Advertiser’s submission of a credit 
application (“Credit App”) via TEGNA’s online portal and TEGNA’s completion of a satisfactory credit check based on the Credit App.  If TEGNA grants 
Advertiser credit terms, payment for Campaigns run thereafter will be due within thirty (30) days of invoice date.  Notwithstanding the foregoing, TEGNA 
reserves the right to revoke Advertiser’s credit in the event TEGNA reasonably determines that Advertiser is no longer creditworthy.  In such an instance, 
TEGNA may require payments for future Campaigns to be on a cash-in-advance basis, in which case Advertiser must make payments in accordance with 
Section 3.2, above.  
3.4. Payment via Payment Cards .  TEGNA, in its discretion, may accept payment via payment cards.  TEGNA reserves the right to impose conditions 
on use of payment cards, including a surcharge on all payments made by Advertiser with a credit card.
3.5. Expenses.  All expenses related to the delivery of Advertiser Content (as defined below) or other materials to TEGNA and the return of such 
materials by TEGNA (if return is directed in writing by Advertiser) shall be paid by Advertiser, it being understood that digital assets will not be returned.  
3.6. Taxes. Any federal, state or local taxes applicable to the transactions contemplated by this Agreement shall be assumed and paid by Advertiser.
3.7. Late Payment. If Advertiser fails to timely pay invoiced amounts, TEGNA may suspend the Campaigns running hereunder and/or immediately 
terminate this Agreement.  If any amount is not paid by Advertiser when due, such amount shall bear interest at the rate of eighteen percent (18%) per 
annum or the maximum amount permitted by law (whichever is lower), computed from the original due date until paid.  Without limiting the foregoing, if 
Advertiser’s account remains unpaid for thirty (30) days or more past the due date, TEGNA reserves the right to suspend all Campaigns until all such 
overdue amounts (and any applicable interest charges, as specified above) are paid.  In addition, Advertiser agrees to reimburse TEGNA for all expenses 
incurred by TEGNA in connection with the collection of amounts payable hereunder, including court costs and reasonable attorneys’ fees.  
3.8. Billing. Any claims by Advertiser for a credit related to Campaigns under this Agreement (e.g., billing disputes, claims that Campaigns ran in the 
wrong time slot, etc.) must be submitted in writing to TEGNA within ninety (90) days of the invoice date or the claim will be deemed to have been waived. 
If Advertiser disputes any amounts owed hereunder, Advertiser will pay all amounts not in dispute no later than the due date for the applicable invoice.  
3.9. Performance-Based Billing.
3.9.1. Ratings.  No increase or deduction will be made from the charges owed to TEGNA because the rating or audience share of one or more 
programs is more or less than TEGNA or Advertiser had anticipated or predicted.  Advertiser acknowledges and agrees that the ratings used for the 
purpose of calculating the price of advertising sold hereunder are only an estimate and that, except as TEGNA and Advertiser may explicitly agree in 
writing with respect to a particular Campaign, TEGNA does not guarantee that the program(s) in which the advertising runs will achieve such ratings.  
Accordingly, no rebate will be made by TEGNA if actual program ratings fall below the estimated amounts and no additional consideration will be due and 
payable by Advertiser if actual program ratings exceed the estimated amount.
3.9.2. Impressions. 
3.9.2.1. To the extent the Confirmation contemplates a guaranteed number of impressions for a Campaign, TEGNA will run such Campaign until the total 
number of impressions has been delivered.  Without limiting the foregoing, for a time-sensitive Campaign, if TEGNA fails to deliver the specified number
of impressions for any reason other than for Advertiser’s breach of this Agreement, TEGNA will provide Advertiser with a make-good of equivalent value 
or pro rata refund, as mutually agreed upon.
3.9.2.2. For any Campaign distributed on Third-Party Streaming Platforms (as defined below), if the Confirmation contemplates that the guaranteed 
impressions will be delivered in a specific geographic market and TEGNA is not able to secure the inventory to run such impressions within a time frame 
specified by Advertiser, then TEGNA will deliver the available impressions and Advertiser only will be obligated to pay for impressions actually delivered (in 
which case TEGNA will either roll any pre-paid amounts associated with impressions not delivered into the following month’s Campaign or, if there are no 
subsequent Campaigns scheduled, refund such pre-paid amounts).      
4. Advertising Materials.  
4.1. Content. Advertiser may, from time to time, provide TEGNA with advertising materials, including, without limitation, text, data, video, audio, 
images, illustrations, graphics, trademarks, service marks, and logos (collectively, “ Advertiser Content”) for use in connection with TEGNA’s creation and 
distribution of the Campaigns purchased hereunder.  
4.2. Licenses. Subject to Advertiser’s ownership rights under Section 7, below and to the terms of the applicable Confirmation, Advertiser hereby
grants TEGNA and its designees (including, as applicable, the owners of the programming and the platforms over which Campaigns may be distributed) a 
non-exclusive, worldwide, transferable, sub-licensable right and license (i) to use, reproduce, perform, display, distribute, and modify (solely for technical 
reasons) the Advertiser Content (or any portion thereof) via broadcast television (including any TEGNA-authorized retransmission of TEGNA’s signal or the 
content thereof), terrestrial radio, and/or Digital Media Property(ies) (collectively, the “ TEGNA Platforms ”); (ii) to modify, copy, reformat, broadcast, 
transmit, retransmit and otherwise manipulate the Advertiser Content (in ease case, for technical reasons as necessary to distribute the ad hereunder) in 
connection with such display; and (iii) to use Advertiser’s name and logo in connection with servicing the Campaigns.  For purposes of these Standard 
Terms, “Digital Media Properties ” include, without limitation, (a) TEGNA’s traditional and mobile website(s), tablet, mobile and streaming applications, 
social media platforms, and channels distributed on free, ad supported streaming television (“ FAST”) services (e.g., Prime Video, Samsung TV+, Tubi,  
Vizio, etc.) (collectively, “ TEGNA Digital Properties”) and (b) third-party digital streaming products and services, such as “TV Everywhere” services offered 
by traditional cable providers, over-the-top (“ OTT”) video streaming platforms (e.g., Hulu, YouTube TV, Paramount+, Discovery Plus, etc.), applications on 
connected TV services (e.g., Apple TV, Roku, etc.) and FAST services (the services in this clause 4.2(b) are, collectively, “Third-Party Streaming Platforms”).    
4.3. Clearances.  Advertiser will be responsible, at its own cost and expense, for obtaining all clearances, authorizations, permissions, licenses, and 
releases (collectively, “Clearances”) from third parties necessary to enable TEGNA to exercise its rights under Section 4.2, including, without limitation, (i) 
Clearances for any of the following creative elements appearing in or otherwise displayed via the Advertiser Content: photos, video footage, music 
(including, without limitation, any synchronization and mechanical licenses), audio tracks, trademarks, service marks, and rights of publicity and other 
indicia of identity, and (ii) Clearances from any individuals or entities whose trademarks, service marks, other corporate indicia, names, voices, likenesses, 
and other indicia of identity may appear in any of the Advertiser Content.
4.4. Advertiser Approval Right.  To the extent that TEGNA develops any creative or other deliverables on behalf of Advertiser under any Confirmation 
(“Deliverables”), Advertiser will have two (2) business days from receipt of any such Deliverable to review and approve the Deliverable. Advertiser must 
notify TEGNA in writing of any rejection of the Deliverable within two (2) business days after receipt thereof or the Deliverable will be deemed approved 
by Advertiser.  Advertiser will not unreasonably withhold its approval.  Only one (1) round of revisions shall be provided unless otherwise agreed by 
TEGNA. Additional corrections or modifications will be subject to an additional charge and may result in delays in the Campaign start date.
4.5. Technical Quality; Typographical Errors; Incorrect Insertions or Omissions .  TEGNA will not be responsible for any material that is not properly 
displayed or that cannot be accessed or viewed because the material was not received by TEGNA in the proper form, in a timely manner, or in an 
acceptable technical quality for display on any TEGNA Platforms.  TEGNA will not be liable for typographical errors, incorrect insertions or incorrect 
publication or omissions in any Advertiser Content displayed or published pursuant to this Agreement or omitted from broadcast or digital publication.
4.6. Failure to Display Advertiser Content.  TEGNA is not required to display any Advertiser Content or other material for the benefit of any person or 
entity other than Advertiser. If there is an interruption or omission of the broadcast and/or publication of any Advertiser Content or other material 
contracted to be broadcast and/or published hereunder, TEGNA may suggest a substitute time period for the broadcast and/or publication of the 
interrupted or omitted Advertiser Content or material or run the Campaigns on the applicable station broadcast television feed or on the Digital Media 
Properties during an equivalent alternate time period, as determined by TEGNA.  Alternatively, in cases where Advertiser has paid in advance and either 
TEGNA does not offer a substitute time period or no such substitute time period is reasonably acceptable to Advertiser in Advertiser’s good faith business 
judgment, TEGNA shall provide a “make good” in the form of a reduction in the amount of fees due to TEGNA (or credit of fees already paid) equal to the 
proportionate amount of money assigned to the interrupted or omitted Campaign(s).  Such substitution in time period or placement or reduction in fees 
shall be Advertiser’s sole and exclusive remedy for any failure to display Campaigns or other advertising material and TEGNA shall have no further liability 
hereunder for such failure.
4.7. Deadlines. Advertiser will deliver to TEGNA all applicable Advertiser Content by TEGNA’s standard deadline (as designated by TEGNA from time 
to time), in a format suitable for display on broadcast television or on the Digital Media Properties, as applicable, via a transmission method specified by 
TEGNA.  Advertiser shall have the right to change any Campaigns after submission, provided that it submits any such changes to TEGNA no later than 
TEGNA’s standard submission deadline (as designated by TEGNA).  Changes to any Campaigns after first broadcast or publication will result in additional 
charges, which will be disclosed to Advertiser in advance.
5. Ad Serving on Digital Media Properties.  
5.1. TEGNA Digital Properties.
5.1.1. TEGNA Ad Serving.  If TEGNA will be responsible for serving Campaigns on the TEGNA Digital Properties, then TEGNA will track delivery of such 
Campaigns.  The parties agree that TEGNA’s final impression measurements will be used to determine the fees due under this Agreement.  
Notwithstanding the foregoing, if Advertiser’s own impression measurements show a discrepancy of ten percent (10%) or more, then Advertiser may 
notify TEGNA and the parties will thereafter meet and discuss in good faith an appropriate resolution, it being understood that TEGNA may invoice 
Advertiser for amounts not in dispute while the dispute resolution discussions are ongoing. 
5.1.2. Third-Party Ad Serving . If a third party will be responsible for serving the Campaigns on the TEGNA Digital Properties, and such third party will 
track delivery of such Campaigns, then notwithstanding Section 5.1.1 above, the third party’s final audited impression measurements will be used to 
determine the fees due under this Agreement.  If the parties agree to use a third-party ad server under the terms of this Agreement, Advertiser agrees to 
provide TEGNA with a user login name and password to access the third party’s impression measurements for purposes of verification of such 
measurements.
5.1.3. National Ads.  Notwithstanding Sections 5.1.1 and 5.1.2, for national Campaigns the Advertiser will be responsible for tracking delivery, and 
TEGNA will invoice based on Advertiser’s tracking metrics for such Campaigns.  Advertiser agrees to provide TEGNA with direct login access to Advertiser’s 
impression measurements for purposes of verification of such measurements.
5.2. Third-Party Streaming Platforms.
5.2.1. Ad Serving.  For Campaigns running on Third-Party Streaming Platforms, if the Third-Party Streaming Platform operator is responsible for ad 
serving then such operator will track delivery of such Campaigns through its ad servers and the operator’s final impression measurements will be used to 
determine the fees due under this Agreement.  Notwithstanding the foregoing, if Advertiser’s own impression measurements show a discrepancy of ten 
percent (10%) or more, then Advertiser may notify TEGNA and the parties will thereafter meet and discuss in good faith an appropriate resolution, it being 
understood that TEGNA may invoice Advertiser for amounts not in dispute while the dispute resolution discussions are ongoing.
5.2.2. Campaigns Served by a Third Party .   If a third party designated by Advertiser will be responsible for serving Advertiser’s Campaigns on Third-
Party Streaming Platforms, then such third party will track delivery of such Campaigns and notwithstanding Section 5.2.1 above, the third party’s final 
audited impression measurements will be used to determine the fees due under this Agreement.  If the parties agree to use a third-party ad server under 
the terms of this Agreement, Advertiser agrees to provide TEGNA and/or the applicable Third-Party Streaming Platform with a user login name and 
password to access the third party’s impression measurements for purposes of verification of such measurements.
5.2.3. Reporting.  TEGNA will use commercially reasonable efforts to make Campaign-specific reporting for Campaigns on Digital Media Platforms 
(“Digital Campaigns”) available to Advertiser within five (5) business days after the end of the Campaign. Reports will be generated via an online reporting 
dashboard or such other method determined by the applicable Third-Party Streaming Platform operator and will be delivered to Advertiser either via 
direct access to the dashboard (if requested by Advertiser) or via email.  If Advertiser requests third-party reporting (e.g., Nielsen data), TEGNA will use 
commercially reasonable efforts to provide such reporting for an additional fee (payable by Advertiser in advance), and subject to availability from the 
applicable third party.
5.2.4. Audience Targeting.  To the extent a Digital Campaign contemplates audience targeting, TEGNA may fulfill the targeting requests using data 
segments obtained from third-party data providers.  Demographic targeting may be fulfilled (i) contextually based on available impressions, (ii) based on 
validated and indexed audiences, in each case, as specified in the Confirmation, or (iii) based on third-party data segments.  While TEGNA (directly or via 
the Third-Party Streaming Platform operator) will deliver Digital Campaigns to the targeting parameters outlined in the applicable Confirmation, TEGNA 
makes no promises or guarantees regarding the composition of any data segments used in a targeted Digital Campaign.
6. TEGNA’s Rights.  
6.1. Reservation of Rights. TEGNA may reject, remove or cancel any Campaign or position commitment at any time in its sole discretion.  TEGNA also
